-- Industry -- AnzsicClass.AnzsicClassName
SELECT
NULL AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,BC.EmployeeId AS EmployerName
,NULL AS AddressLine1
,NULL AS AddressLine2
,NULL AS AddressLine3
,NULL AS LocationSK
,BA.AnzsicClassName AS Industry
,NULL AS Designation
,BC.FinancialInstitutionId AS BankSK
,NULL AS BranchSK
,NULL AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12--31' AS ValidEndDate
,NULL AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CUSTOMEREMPLOYMENT BC
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Employer BE ON BC.EmployerId = BE.EmployerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.AnzsicClass BA ON BE.AnzsicClassCode = BA.AnzsicClassCode

UNION
